description: A central sector scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmer families in the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and domestic requirements.
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months transferred directly into bank accounts.

additional_conditions: Farmer family owning cultivable land in their names
Excludes institutional landholders, serving/retired government officials, and income tax payees

documents_required: Land ownership record (7/12 extract or Jamabandi)
application_procedure: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in portal or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with land record and Aadhaar.
source_department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

description: A Maharashtra state welfare scheme providing monthly financial assistance to destitute persons, blind, disabled, orphans, and persons suffering from severe illness who have no source of livelihood.
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 for eligible single beneficiaries and ₹2,400 for families with two or more beneficiaries.

additional_conditions: Permanent resident of Maharashtra for at least 15 years
Annual family income must not exceed ₹21,000

documents_required: Income certificate issued by Tahsildar (annual income under ₹21,000)
Disability certificate (if applying under disability category)
application_procedure: Submit application form at the Tahsildar office or Aaple Sarkar portal in Maharashtra.

metadata.target_group: Destitute and Senior Citizens of Maharashtra

scheme_name: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students - Maharashtra
scheme_name_hi: महाराष्ट्र अनुसूचित जाति के लिए भारत सरकार मैट्रिकोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति
scheme_name_mr: महाराष्ट्र अनुसूचित जातीसाठी भारत सरकार मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती
description: Financial scholarship to enable Scheduled Caste students of Maharashtra to pursue post-matriculation or post-secondary education.
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
benefits: Full reimbursement of tuition fees, examination fees, and monthly maintenance allowance.

additional_conditions: Candidate must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category
Family annual income must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh
Enrolled in a recognized post-matric course

documents_required: Caste Certificate issued by competent authority
College Admission Fee Receipt and Allotment Letter
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account
application_procedure: Apply online through the MahaDBT portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in).
source_department: Social Justice Department, Government of Maharashtra

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
scheme_name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (पीएम-जय)
scheme_name_mr: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (पीएम-जय)
description: World's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization care to vulnerable and economically weaker families.
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across empanelled hospitals.

additional_conditions: Families identified under deprivation and occupational criteria of Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011)
Also extended to all citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of income

documents_required: PM-JAY Beneficiary ID or Ayushman Card
application_procedure: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit any empanelled public or private hospital with Aadhaar and Ration Card to generate Ayushman Card.
source_department: National Health Authority, Government of India

metadata.target_group: Economically vulnerable families and senior citizens 70+
